Content-aware crop: edges, skin colour, saturation, optional boosts
(for faces). The library is classic JS already (UMD). GifOS adds
Twitter-style aspect presets, a still from Take photo, skin-region
boxes used as face boosts (no extra model), and keeps the last picture
inside the file.
